name: Vela Reveal
summary: In the Akeia matriarchy, a figure long spoken of in hints and glances steps forward at last. The player meets Vela — and nothing about the story is quite the same afterward.
comment: Concordia Phase 15 — bespoke cinematic for the Vela reveal beat. Triggered when the player first interacts with the Vela NPC in the Akeia matriarchy.
